$description:
Kiln · the styles. index.html loads these files in this order (the order matters where rules meet):
   tokens · base · layout · scrolledge · prompt · controls · chips · tabs · picture · queue · loras · pnginfo · dialogs ·
   overlays · glass · themes/* · motion. One rule per thing, grouped by part of the screen.
   States are classes JS sets (body.glass / .private / .jobrun…, .app.stacked / .pright, .frame.has / .held…).
   !important is kept only where a rule must beat an inline style or every other rule (cursor and transition
   switches while you drag, the morph); each one says why. */
